title: OpenAI Launches GPT-6 in ChatGPT With Dynamic 'Intelligent UI'
seoTitle: OpenAI Launches GPT-6 in ChatGPT With Intelligent UI
description: OpenAI brings GPT-6 Sol and Luna to ChatGPT, adding an Intelligent UI feature that generates interactive forms, custom tools, and responsive diagrams.
dek: ChatGPT updates its core chat experience with GPT-6 Sol and Luna, generating interactive widgets, calculators, and diagrams while delivering quicker responses by interleaving thinking with answering.
keyTakeaways: OpenAI deployed GPT-6 Sol to paid ChatGPT tiers and GPT-6 Luna to Free and Go users for everyday conversations in the Chat tab.
Intelligent UI introduces interactive visual components such as forms, tappable buttons, sliders, dynamic maps, and on-demand mini tools.
A streaming compiler allows interface elements to render progressively as the model generates them.
GPT-6 interleaves thinking with answering, starting web search responses 44 percent faster on average than GPT-5.6 Instant, according to OpenAI.
body:
OpenAI announced on October 7, 2026, that it has updated the ChatGPT Chat tab with new GPT-6 model variants and introduced Intelligent UI, an interface system that pairs standard text output with dynamic, interactive visual components. The company is deploying the update to more than 1.2 billion weekly active users, according to [OpenAI's official announcement](https://openai.com/index/gpt-6-for-everyone/).

The rollout separates access across user tiers: GPT-6 Sol powers ChatGPT Plus, Pro, Business, and Enterprise plans, while GPT-6 Luna powers the Free and Go tiers. The transition focuses on the Chat experience; OpenAI noted that models supporting its Work and Codex products remain unchanged.

## Moving Past Text Walls With Dynamic Components

ChatGPT has predominantly been a text-based interface. With Intelligent UI, the chatbot assembles interfaces using graphics, tappable buttons, data entry forms, interactive charts, and miniature apps built on the fly, as reported by [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/07/chatgpt-is-getting-a-lot-more-visual-with-the-launch-of-a-new-interface/).

Instead of reading through text explanations, users can engage with interactive widgets designed for specific questions. During press demonstrations, OpenAI showed instances where the model constructed diagrams explaining how airplane wings produce lift and created custom widgets for multi-day hiking routes, bicycle mechanics, and recipe adjustments.

According to hands-on testing by [WIRED](https://www.wired.com/story/openai-chatgpt-intelligent-ui-is-more-show-than-tell/), the interface generated an interactive anatomical diagram of a slug with inspectable parts, an apartment affordability calculator with variable income sliders, and an airplane seating layout comparing Delta and Alaska flights with interactive seat maps.

[[FIG1]]

OpenAI product manager Aarush Selvan stated that users trying to solve everyday problems often require more than static text. OpenAI also made the visual density adjustable, allowing users who prefer plain text to instruct ChatGPT to produce fewer interactive elements if an interface feels cluttered.

## Under the Hood: Streaming Components and Compilers

To make dynamic interfaces functional in real-time conversations across web and mobile platforms, OpenAI engineered a dedicated rendering pipeline. According to [OpenAI's engineering details](https://openai.com/index/gpt-6-for-everyone/), the system relies on a library of native, streamable components coupled with an on-the-fly compiler.

When a user submits a prompt, GPT-6 determines whether a visual or interactive format suits the context better than standard prose. The model selects components from the library, organizing layouts to fit comparisons side by side or presenting steps inside an interactive framework.

Rather than waiting for the entire code and UI structure to complete before rendering, the compiler processes and streams the interface progressively.

[[FIG2]]

OpenAI explained that it expanded training protocols to evaluate the interfaces generated by GPT-6 for clarity, utility, and completeness. The training also taught the model when to bypass complex layouts in favor of direct, plain-text answers.

## Interleaved Reasoning and Faster Search

Alongside interface changes, OpenAI updated how the underlying model handles complex reasoning tasks. Previous reasoning models required users to wait until the entire reasoning chain concluded before outputting the first token of an answer.

With GPT-6, ChatGPT interleaves thinking with answering, as detailed by [MacRumors](https://www.macrumors.com/2026/10/07/chatgpt-intelligent-ui/). The model composes partial responses using findings gathered during early processing, progressively refining and adding detail without forcing users to sit through prolonged blank screens.

OpenAI reported that for queries requiring web search, GPT-6 Instant begins answering 44 percent sooner on average than GPT-5.6 Instant. In company benchmarks covering agentic everyday workflows, GPT-6 Extra High began answering in the same timeframe as GPT-5.6 Medium while achieving a better overall score than GPT-5.6 Extra High.

Internal evaluations cited by OpenAI also showed GPT-6 addressing key aspects of complex user inquiries more consistently than GPT-5.6 when consulting web sources, improving source selection and reducing irrelevant filler.

## Safety Controls and Ecosystem Integration

OpenAI reported that GPT-6 incorporates safety advances originally introduced in Astra, specifically strengthening protections against multi-turn jailbreak attempts and high-risk misuse related to violence, cyberattacks, and biological hazards. According to OpenAI, the model uses full conversation history to evaluate risk context while reducing unnecessary refusals on benign prompts.

[[FIG3]]

The move toward interactive, structured conversational elements also aligns with commercial partner integrations on the platform. In an implementation profile published by [OpenAI](https://openai.com/index/radisson/), Radisson Hotel Group worked with Accenture Song to build a ChatGPT plugin that allows users to explore lodging options on interactive maps and view pricing directly in chat, which Radisson reported delivered a visit-to-booking conversion rate roughly 1.5 times that of its traditional organic search.

## Rollout and Tier Availability

Access to GPT-6 and Intelligent UI began October 7, 2026, for ChatGPT Plus, Pro, Business, and Enterprise subscribers, as noted by [9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/10/07/openai-brings-gpt-6-to-chatgpt-and-debuts-intelligent-ui/). Availability for Enterprise users remains subject to individual organization administrator settings.

Beginning October 8, 2026, OpenAI expands the rollout to Free and Go tier accounts using the GPT-6 Luna variant, bringing the dynamic interface tools to the broader consumer base.

faq.q: Which GPT-6 models power the ChatGPT tiers?
faq.a: ChatGPT Plus, Pro, Business, and Enterprise accounts receive GPT-6 Sol, while Free and Go tier users receive GPT-6 Luna.

faq.q: Can users turn off or reduce the visual components in Intelligent UI?
faq.a: Yes. OpenAI stated that users can customize output preferences and prompt ChatGPT to return simpler text answers if they prefer not to see widgets and diagrams.

faq.q: Does this update apply to OpenAI's coding tools and Work products?
faq.a: No. The GPT-6 and Intelligent UI release is confined to the standard ChatGPT Chat tab. Models powering Codex and Work products remain unchanged.

faq.q: How does GPT-6 speed up reasoning and web search answers?
faq.a: GPT-6 interleaves thinking with answering, streaming partial findings as it reasons. OpenAI reported that web search queries start responding 44 percent faster on average compared to GPT-5.6 Instant.
